City Centre

Pavilion Theatre

An Edwardian variety house on Renfield Street, unrestored and unapologetic, and the last of Glasgow's theatres still run as an independent family business. The Pavilion has never taken public subsidy, and programmes to its own audience rather than to a funder: Scottish comedy, panto that runs for months, tribute nights and homegrown plays that sell out without ever troubling a broadsheet critic.
